name: LG Replacement Refrigerator Water Filter
shortDescription: Keeping your refrigerator in tip top shape with a brand new water filter is a smart move. By changing your LT700PCS water filter on a regular basis, you'll continue to reduce contaminates such as iron, particulates and chlorine in your drinking water and ice cubes. You'll notice the difference!
